signIn.title: Sign in to admin
signIn.note: Only people we have added can sign in. The link works once, for one hour.
signIn.sentBody: If this address can sign in to admin, we have sent a link to it. It works once, for one hour.
signIn.expiredBody: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
signIn.signedOutBody: Your admin session has ended on this device.

email.subject: Your link to sign in to Flowers Overseas admin
email.body: The link works once, for one hour. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Who can sign in to admin. Removing a role or deactivating someone signs them out at once.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until a role is granted again.
users.ownLastAdmin: You cannot remove your own last admin role.
users.conflict: Someone changed this user in the meantime. Nothing was saved; the page shows the current state.
users.invalid: Check the email, the name (2 to 80 characters) and the role.

errors.forbiddenBody: Your roles do not include this page.
errors.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address.
errors.unauthorizedBody: Sign in to admin to continue.
